def make_passwd_line(claims):
    """Create an entry for /etc/passwd based on our claims.  Returns a
    newline-terminated string.
    """
    uname = claims["uid"]
    uid = claims["uidNumber"]
    pwline = "{}:x:{}:{}::/home/{}:/bin/bash\n".format(uname, uid, uid, uname)
    return pwline
